{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ccrz2tMVF53fbVsA7Cb9R","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BJD4yTAjegjZXtC8rYp5fJ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd\nimport numpy as np\n\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\ndf = df.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'orig_idx'})\n\n# Step 1: technical noise (impossible values)\nnoise_mask = ~(df['avg_glucose_level'].between(20,800) & df['bmi'].between(10,60) & (df['age']<=120))\nprint('noise rows:', noise_mask.sum())\nprint(df.loc[noise_mask, ['orig_idx','age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']].to_string())\nd1 = df[~noise_mask].copy()\nprint('remaining:', len(d1))\n\n# Step 2: 3*IQR outliers on each numeric var\ndef iqr_bounds(s, k=3):\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile(0.25), s.quantile(0.75)\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return q1 - k*iqr, q3 + k*iqr\n\nfor col in ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']:\n    lo, hi = iqr_bounds(d1[col])\n    m = (d1[col] < lo) | (d1[col] > hi)\n    print(col, 'bounds', round(lo,2), round(hi,2), 'outliers:', m.sum())\n\n# glucose outliers stroke check\nlo, hi = iqr_bounds(d1['avg_glucose_level'])\ngm = (d1['avg_glucose_level'] < lo) | (d1['avg_glucose_level'] > hi)\nprint('glucose outliers stroke fraction:', d1.loc[gm,'stroke'].mean(), 'n=', gm.sum())\nprint(d1.loc[gm, ['orig_idx','avg_glucose_level','stroke']].to_string())\n\n# log2 retry\ng2 = np.log2(d1['avg_glucose_level'])\nlo2, hi2 = iqr_bounds(g2)\ngm2 = (g2 < lo2) | (g2 > hi2)\nprint('log2 glucose outliers:', gm2.sum(), 'stroke fraction:', d1.loc[gm2,'stroke'].mean() if gm2.sum() else 'NA')\nEOF","description":"Explore noise rows and IQR outliers"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":755,"cache_read_input_tokens":21864,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":755,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ff40d8dd-7078-4673-ab75-c7a98b5169bc","uuid":"0527ed2b-83e3-4533-8baa-8f84c82b9f2c","request_id":"req_011Ccrz2sUetKGzeqfLgUJDf"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrzA5LEgZRny9nwu2175","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019kHNc6GkwtQgSNLE4nTDTd","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv').reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'orig_idx'})\nnoise_mask = ~(df['avg_glucose_level'].between(20,800) & df['bmi'].between(10,60) & (df['age']<=120))\nd1 = df[~noise_mask].copy()  # 2440 rows, no IQR removals\n\n# risk proxy: product of normalized (by max) numerical features\nfor c in ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']:\n    d1[c+'_n'] = d1[c] / d1[c].max()\nd1['risk_proxy'] = d1['age_n'] * d1['bmi_n'] * d1['avg_glucose_level_n']\n\ndef mahal_outliers(X, alpha=0.01):\n    mu = X.mean(axis=0)\n    cov = np.cov(X, rowvar=False)\n    inv = np.linalg.inv(cov)\n    diff = X - mu\n    d2 = np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i', diff, inv, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(1-alpha, df=X.shape[1])\n    return d2 > crit, crit\n\nfor cols in [['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level'],\n             ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level','risk_proxy']]:\n    X = d1[cols].to_numpy()\n    m, crit = mahal_outliers(X)\n    print(cols, 'crit=', round(crit,3), 'outliers:', m.sum())\n    print(' idx:', d1.loc[m,'orig_idx'].tolist())\n\n# categorical checks - interpretations\nsmoke = d1['smoking_status'].isin(['smokes','formerly smoked'])\nA = smoke & (d1['work_type']=='children')\nB = smoke & (d1['age']<=14)\nC = smoke & ((d1['work_type']=='children') | (d1['age']<=14))\nD = (d1['work_type']=='children') & (d1['age']>14)\nT = (d1['work_type']=='student') & (d1['age']<=3)\nprint('\\nA smoke&worktype_children:', A.sum(), d1.loc[A,'orig_idx'].tolist())\nprint('B smoke&age<=14:', B.sum(), d1.loc[B,'orig_idx'].tolist())\nprint('C smoke&(children|age<=14):', C.sum(), d1.loc[C,'orig_idx'].tolist())\nprint('D worktype_children&age>14:', D.sum(), d1.loc[D,'orig_idx'].tolist())\nprint('T student&age<=3:', T.sum(), d1.loc[T,'orig_idx'].tolist())\nprint('\\nwork_type children ages:', sorted(d1.loc[d1.work_type=='children','age'].unique()))\nprint('students age dist:', d1.loc[d1.work_type=='student','age'].describe()[['min','max']].tolist())\nprint('smoking among work children:', d1.loc[d1.work_type=='children','smoking_status'].value_counts().to_dict())\nEOF","description":"Compute Mahalanobis and categorical outliers under variants"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":290,"cache_read_input_tokens":30889,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":290,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ff40d8dd-7078-4673-ab75-c7a98b5169bc","uuid":"6d68a900-4f4a-46da-b33f-4ad62843dccb","request_id":"req_011CcrzA4YrVURn29wEVjqAx"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrzDVMCEUFgZ7wyPPHci","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ApXKQwCeV9Baah3aQmKcSp","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"\"\"\"Identify unusual values in the synthetic stroke dataset.\n\nPipeline:\n1. Discard technical noise (values outside realistic thresholds) - these are\n   noise, not outliers, and are not part of the returned outlier list.\n2. 3*IQR outlier detection on age, bmi, avg_glucose_level. Glucose outliers\n   are checked against the stroke-association rule (>=50% stroke -> keep;\n   >20% -> log2-transform and re-check).\n3. Remove standard outliers, build risk_proxy = product of max-normalized\n   numerical features.\n4. Mahalanobis-distance outliers over the numerical variables (incl.\n   risk_proxy), squared distance vs chi-square critical value at 0.01.\n5. Categorical outliers: children (work_type 'children' or age <= 14) who\n   smoke / formerly smoked, and toddlers (age <= 3) who are students.\n\nIndices are mapped back to the original matrix (row 0 = first data row)\nvia the unique patient_id.\n\"\"\"\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUMERIC_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\n\n\ndef iqr_outlier_mask(series: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = series.quantile(0.25), series.quantile(0.75)\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (series < q1 - k * iqr) | (series > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef glucose_outliers_with_stroke_rule(data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:\n    \"\"\"3*IQR outliers on avg_glucose_level, verified against the stroke rule.\n\n    If >=50% of the observations sharing the outlying values are stroke\n    cases, they are not outliers. If more than 20% are stroke cases, apply\n    a log2 transformation and repeat the check on the transformed variable.\n    \"\"\"\n    values = data[\"avg_glucose_level\"]\n    while True:\n        mask = iqr_outlier_mask(values)\n        if not mask.any():\n            return mask\n        stroke_share = data.loc[mask, \"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_share >= 0.5:\n            return pd.Series(False, index=data.index)\n        if stroke_share > 0.2:\n            values = np.log2(values)\n            continue\n        return mask\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    # unique variable used to map filtered rows back to original indices\n    id_to_index = {pid: i for i, pid in enumerate(df[\"patient_id\"])}\n\n    # 1. discard technical noise (impossible values)\n    realistic = (\n        df[\"avg_glucose_level\"].between(20, 800)\n        & df[\"bmi\"].between(10, 60)\n        & (df[\"age\"] <= 120)\n    )\n    data = df[realistic].copy()\n\n    # 2. 3*IQR outliers per numeric variable\n    iqr_mask = iqr_outlier_mask(data[\"age\"]) | iqr_outlier_mask(data[\"bmi\"])\n    iqr_mask |= glucose_outliers_with_stroke_rule(data)\n    iqr_outliers = [id_to_index[p] for p in data.loc[iqr_mask, \"patient_id\"]]\n    data = data[~iqr_mask].copy()\n\n    # 3. risk proxy: product of numerical features normalized by their max\n    data[\"risk_proxy\"] = 1.0\n    for col in NUMERIC_COLS:\n        data[\"risk_proxy\"] *= data[col] / data[col].max()\n\n    # 4. Mahalanobis distance outliers over the numerical variables\n    X = data[NUMERIC_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]].to_numpy()\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    critical = chi2.ppf(1 - 0.01, df=X.shape[1])\n    maha_mask = pd.Series(d2 > critical, index=data.index)\n    maha_outliers = [id_to_index[p] for p in data.loc[maha_mask, \"patient_id\"]]\n    data = data[~maha_mask].copy()\n\n    # 5. categorical outliers: smoking children and toddler students\n    is_child = (data[\"work_type\"] == \"children\") | (data[\"age\"] <= 14)\n    smokes = data[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"])\n    is_toddler_student = (data[\"work_type\"] == \"student\") & (data[\"age\"] <= 3)\n    cat_mask = (is_child & smokes) | is_toddler_student\n    cat_outliers = [id_to_index[p] for p in data.loc[cat_mask, \"patient_id\"]]\n\n    result = []\n    for idx in iqr_outliers + maha_outliers + cat_outliers:\n        if idx not in result:\n            result.append(idx)\n    return result\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4656,"cache_read_input_tokens":31179,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4656,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ff40d8dd-7078-4673-ab75-c7a98b5169bc","uuid":"38dd0d86-e6a0-4ee9-ab68-acdf4dd26026","request_id":"req_011CcrzDUeXLqCH6XphEFLHv"}
